items.title: 🦛 USA: Fiona, Cincinnati Zoo’s famous hippo, has died
items.summary: 🦛Fiona, Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo, has died aged just 9, after swallowing a knitted hat that fell into her enclosure. Born prematurely and weighing only 13kg, she captured millions of hearts around the world and became an internet sensation.

items.title: Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a visitor's hat
items.summary: Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo's much-loved hippopotamus, has died after swallowing a knitted hat that became stuck in her digestive system. Vets made several attempts to remove the object but were unable to save the nine-year-old animal.
